classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.strength: 400 mg/100 mg tablet (standard; not printed on PDL)
preferredAgent.sig: No cirrhosis or compensated cirrhosis: 1 tablet once daily for 12 weeks. Decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B or C): 1 tablet once daily plus weight-based ribavirin for 12 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 1 tab QD x12 wk (+ribavirin if decompensated)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks; people with advanced liver scarring also take ribavirin.

paRequired.reason: PA required (PDL p.6); generic sofosbuvir/velpatasvir is preferred

records.verificationNote: Read DC PDL p.6 (Hepatitis C Agents). Preferred: Mavyret, generic sofosbuvir/velpatasvir and Vosevi, all no PA. PA: Epclusa, Harvoni, generic ledipasvir/sofosbuvir and Zepatier. Pegasys vial and ribavirin are preferred but are not in the class description. Pick is generic sofosbuvir/velpatasvir; strength and 12-week duration are standard label dosing, not printed on PDL.

records.verificationNote: Generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir and ledipasvir-sofosbuvir are F with no PA (PDF p.12). Their brands Epclusa, Harvoni and Sovaldi are NF with PA. Mavyret is F with no flag. Generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir is the lowest-barrier pick. The generic is not a brand-over-generic preference, so boglActive is false. Vosevi and Zepatier are not in the document. Strength and duration are label dosing.

records.verificationNote: Read on PDF pp.25-26: EPCLUSA TAB 400-100 Tier 4, PA and QL (28 tabs every 28 days). Every listed DAA needs PA, so Epclusa is picked as the lowest-barrier, widely written option on the same PA terms. Harvoni (ledipasvir-sofosbuvir), Vosevi and Sovaldi are listed with PA; Sovaldi also carries step therapy. Mavyret (glecaprevir-pibrentasvir) and Zepatier (elbasvir-grazoprevir) are not on this document; absence is not read as exclusion.
